companion.title: Connect Companion
companion.description: Create a persistent Home Assistant link on your [Companion connections page]({connections_url}), then paste its HA credential here. The same car must have recent state of charge, range and odometer data. This source currently supplies core vehicle data only; additional Direct NIO sensors will be unavailable.

confirm_source.title: Switch this vehicle to Companion?
confirm_source.description: Keep this vehicle's entities, dashboard settings and history, and read its core telemetry from Companion. Direct-only sensors will become unavailable. The previous configuration is restored if the new source cannot load. A paused entry will enable Companion only after validation. A return to Direct NIO may require NIO authorization again.

vehicle.title: Add your NIO vehicle
vehicle.description: Enter the vehicle identity after authorizing Home Assistant with NIO.

abort.source_unload_failed: The current connection could not stop. No source change was saved.
abort.source_switch_failed: The new connection could not load. The previous configuration was restored.
abort.source_rollback_failed: The switch failed and the previous configuration was restored, but could not load. Check the integration and reconnect if needed.

error.persistent_credential_required: Use a persistent Companion HA credential, not a temporary proof token.
error.consumer_reauthentication_required: This HA credential was rejected. Create a new HA link on the Companion connections page.
error.upstream_reauthorization_required: Reconnect NIO on the Companion connections page; keep your existing HA credential.
error.source_disconnected: Reconnect your NIO source on the Companion connections page.
error.retry_later: Companion is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.identity_mismatch: This Companion link belongs to a different vehicle.
error.insufficient_coverage: Companion needs recent, verified state of charge, range and odometer data before this switch.
error.source_unload_failed: The existing connection could not stop. Try again later.
error.source_switch_failed: The switch failed. The previous configuration was restored.
error.source_rollback_failed: The previous configuration was restored but could not load. Check the integration before retrying.

companion_source_reconnect.title: Reconnect NIO in Companion
companion_source_reconnect.description: Your upstream NIO connection needs attention. Open the [Companion connections page]({connections_url}) and reconnect NIO. Keep the existing Home Assistant link: its credential remains valid. Home Assistant will resume cached reads automatically when the source recovers.

application_credentials.description: Create or open your Personal Application in the [NIO Open Telematics developer console]({console_url}), set its OAuth redirect URI exactly to [{redirect_url}]({redirect_url}), then enter its Client ID and Client Secret.

init.title: Vehicle dashboard
init.description: Optional vehicle and household sources. Leave a vehicle source empty to use its NIO entity automatically; connection and power can come from any HA charger, and EVCC is not required. History session import requires the EVCC-compatible format.

data.language: Dashboard language (auto follows each viewer's Home Assistant language)
data.soc_entity: State of charge entity (optional NIO override)
data.cost_solar: Recorded solar charging energy entity (cumulative kWh)
data.evcc_connected: Charger connected entity (EVCC or other HA source)
data.evcc_power: Charging power entity (EVCC or other HA source)
data.full_range_km: Range at full charge (km; ledger fallback)

error.ledger_calibration_required: Set usable battery capacity and full-charge range before enabling history.
error.incomplete_cost_sources: Set all five recorded-cost sources or leave them empty.
